author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
It’s officially back to school season! 📚 

Get access to the same programs that you'll use on the job after you graduate - for over 70% off if you’re a student.  

Creative Cloud Pro subscriptions include industry-standard apps like Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Premiere, and more, so you can craft pro-level work using the same tools that working creatives use every day.
title: Get access to the same programs that you'll use after you graduate for 70% off #shorts
